title: Skydive Lancaster

services.name: Tandem skydive
services.desc: After much thought and careful consideration, we have taken the difficult decision to close our tandem operations. We are grateful for those who have shared the joy of skydiving with us, and we are genuinely thankful for those who have supported us along this journey. Skydiving is fun and exciting but can also be a bit scary for anyone that has never experienced it before. So here are a few things that can prepare you for your jump day

services.name: Ready To Dive?
services.desc: A tandem skydive is the easiest way to do your first jump! You will receive roughly 30 minutes of ground school training where you will learn the basics of skydiving - how to properly exit the aircraft, maintain proper body position during free fall, and parachute landing

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Skydiving is the most exhilarating experience you will ever have. People describe the free fall as peaceful, time-stopping, breathtaking, and adrenaline
